claims.object_text: AIS rat and PC12 cell models
claims.quote: we constructed AIS rat and PC12 cell models.
Snap25 gene overexpression significantly inhibited the ferroptosis level
decreased the AIS damage and OGD/R injury level in the model group.

claims.object_text: ferroptosis and OGD/R injury in PC12 cells
claims.quote: Snap25 silencing exacerbated the ferroptosis level and aggravated OGD/R injury in PC12 cells.
The overexpression and silencing of Snap25 can significantly affect the expression level of ROS

claims.object_text: ROS regulation of ferroptosis in AIS
claims.quote: suggesting that the regulatory effect on the ROS level may be an important factor in regulating ferroptosis in AIS by Snap25.

claims.object_text: protective effect against ischemia/reperfusion injury by reducing ROS and ferroptosis
claims.quote: Snap25 has a protective effect against ischemia/reperfusion injury by reducing ROS levels and ferroptosis levels.
